Yes. Here is the simple breakdown:

• Face basics: foundation, concealer, and powder. This is the easiest place to start if you want your skin to look even, fresh, and polished. The Pack piel luminosa y natural is the best starting point for that.
• Cheeks: blush and bronzer. Blush adds freshness and color, while bronzer adds warmth and soft definition.
• Lips: gloss, balm-style color, or classic lipstick. Gloss gives shine, Melting Glow gives sheer color and hydration, and Comfort & Go gives more pigment with a soft semi-matte finish.
• Eyes: liquid shadows, eye pencils, and mascara. These are great if you want to make the biggest visual impact with just one or two products.
• Tools: brushes make everything easier to apply and blend, especially if you are new to makeup.
